_comment: Registry for kit/scripts/sweep.py. Each key is a skill directory under skills/. `script` is run as `python3 scripts/<script> <abs-repo-path> <args>` from the skill directory; `pipeline` (dependency-audit) is run through bash instead, with `{repo}` substituted for the absolute repository path. `args` are the extra flags always passed (repository-agnostic; use --extra <skill>=<args> on the sweep.py command line for per-run additions). `needs` lists gates this entry requires opt-in for via --needs (git, osv); an empty list means it runs by default. `shape` is `finding-list` (included in the digest) or `freeform` (run, but excluded from the digest).

dependency-audit.pipeline: python3 scripts/parse_manifest.py {repo} {extra} | python3 scripts/osv_batch_query.py - | python3 scripts/osv_to_finding.py -

excluded.feature-flag-inventory: requires --flags-file <flags.json|yaml> and --as-of ISO; no repository-only default
excluded.docker-compose-review: first positional is a compose.yml file, not the repository path
excluded.license-compliance-check: requires --bom <bom.json> and --own-license <SPDX-id>; no repository-path form at all
excluded.public-api-change-check: requires two package directories (old and new), not a single repository path
excluded.sla-error-budget-check: first positional is an OpenSLO YAML file, not the repository path, plus requires --measurements-json-file and --as-of
excluded.github-actions-cost-audit: repository-only form hits the live GitHub Actions API (rung 3, network + auth) unless --runs-json-file is also given
excluded.test-coverage-gap-finder: first positional is a cobertura.xml coverage file, not the repository path; requires --repo separately
